commitResults.messageBody:
- Introduce CommandType enum to represent valid user commands and replace hardcoded string comparisons.

- Extract user input parsing logic into a dedicated Parser class to improve code modularity.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add saving and loading of tasks to hard disk
Add date and time support tasks

commitResults.messageBody:
Move console input, the banner, loading warnings, command responses, errors, and farewells out of JassaBot so presentation details have one clear owner.

Convert JassaBot to an instance-based runner that owns its Storage and Ui dependencies while preserving command behavior and persistence. This creates a clean seam for later TaskList and Parser extractions without coupling them to System.in or System.out.

Introduce TaskList as the owner of task ordering, lookup, addition, removal, and completion-state changes instead of passing a raw ArrayList throughout JassaBot.

Expose an unmodifiable List view to Ui and Storage, and generalize Storage.saveTasks to accept List<Task>. This establishes the stable tasks dependency that future Command classes can execute against while preserving transactional save rollback and all console behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Configure Gradle to build fat JAR

commitResults.messageBody:
Several Java classes use inconsistent Javadoc formatting and sparse API
documentation. Date-time fields are also too terse, while switch labels
and brace spacing vary from the project standard.

Align production and test code with the SE-EDU conventions.
Add required Javadocs, normalize layout, and rename deadline and event
fields to describe their purpose without changing application behavior.

Java changes need a shared style reference that agents can apply
consistently across future work.

Add a project-local SE-EDU Java skill and require agent configurations
to load it for Java creation, modification, review, and refactoring.

Commit messages and branch names need a shared convention that agents can
apply consistently across future repository work.

Add a project-local SE-EDU Git skill and require agent configurations
to load it whenever commits are proposed, created, or amended, or when
branches are named.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add keyword search for task descriptions
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce a case-insensitive find command so users can filter tasks without changing their list. Cover parsing, task matching, and console behavior with unit and UI tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Set up Checkstyle to detect coding style violations
Refactor UI message output with varargs
commitResults.messageBody:
UI messages repeat output calls for each response line.

Extract a showLines(String... lines) helper and use it for welcome,
mark, unmark, add, and delete messages to reduce repetition while
preserving the existing output.

Command handling and save rollback rely on implicit assumptions.
Violations can cause incorrect rollback or missing user feedback.

Add eight assertions with comments explaining their purpose. Check
rollback state, newly added task identity, marker validity, task
counts, and command responses. Keep user input validation separate
so it remains effective when assertions are disabled.

Add regression coverage for partial command markers and enable
assertions in the console UI test instructions.

Verify all 36 JUnit tests, both Checkstyle checks, and all 17 console
UI cases pass on Java 25.

Todo, deadline, and event handlers repeat the same add, save, rollback,
and confirmation steps. This duplication makes it easy for failure
handling to diverge when one handler changes.

Extract a shared helper so each handler validates its own input and
then uses the same transactional addition. Preserve existing output
and restore the task list whenever saving fails.

Validate with all 35 JUnit tests, 17 console UI cases, and Checkstyle.

commitResults.messageTitle: Separate command dispatch from response handling
commitResults.messageBody:
The response method mixes response initialization, input validation,
command dispatch, and error formatting. Its long switch obscures the
common path used by every request.

Extract dispatch into a dedicated method so response handling stays
short and each method has one clear responsibility. Preserve command
types, exit handling, and all user-facing messages.

Validate with all 35 JUnit tests, 17 console UI cases, and Checkstyle.

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace magic command offsets with keyword lengths
commitResults.messageBody:
Task-description parsing uses unexplained offsets of 8, 5, and 4.
Readers must count command characters to understand those values,
while the other command handlers already use keyword lengths.

Derive each offset from its command keyword to make the boundary
explicit and keep parsing consistent across handlers. Preserve all
existing command matching and validation behavior.

Validate with all 35 JUnit tests, 17 console UI cases, and Checkstyle.
